# Positive-Control Fixtures

These fixtures are tiny synthetic controls for the deterministic agent workflow.
They are not real evidence and do not represent real compromise.

The fixtures model only sanitized parser-output rows for `$MFT`, Registry
Run/RunOnce, and Amcache behavior so tests and terminal demos can prove the
pipeline emits a supportable finding when the evidence supports one, and records
self-correction when an unsupported claim is introduced.
